note: The main banks were taken as North Macedonia's three largest by assets, a choice from general knowledge (no central bank or association ranking was read in this pass): Komercijalna banka, Stopanska banka and NLB Banka. Stopanska banka: its Mastercard Standard and Mastercard Platinum credit card pages, read 2026-10-30, its only two credit cards. Both bear 9.50% a year, variable, for a client whose salary or pension isn't paid into the bank (8.55% for one whose is, which the game doesn't track). Both pages give the same membership schedule: 695 denars a year with monthly statements by email, none on 90,000 denars of shop spending in the year; the first year free is introductory, the pension, mortgage and deposit discounts aren't written, and the full 1,500 denars charged after more than 60 days late on a minimum isn't modelled. The monthly repayment is 3% of the total debt; the interest-free period on shop purchases paid in full is 45 days on the Standard and 50 on the Platinum. A withdrawal at the bank's ATMs costs 2.5%, at least 250 denars. Komercijalna banka's and NLB Banka's card terms weren't reached in this pass and aren't written. Wave 4 (30 October 2026): no bank was added. Komercijalna banka, Halkbank and UniBank reset or broke the connection, and Ohridska banka's didn't open (the proxy's tunnel failed); NLB Banka's Visa and Mastercard credit card pages give only a promotional rate of 5.9% to 31 December 2026, without its period, and ProCredit Bank's tariff for individuals (from 6 July 2026) gives its MasterCard and Visa Signature credit cards' rates (12.00%, and 11.00% for salary receivers) in a table that doesn't say by what period, so neither is written.
